title: Adult Swim Sealed Record
description: P7 privacy primitive: a sealed record whose payload is stored externally and can only be unsealed after age requirements are met

payload_ref.description: MinIO URI to the sealed payload object

unsealed_at.description: Null until the record has been unsealed

age_required.description: Minimum age (in whatever unit the seal policy defines) before this record can be unsealed

compression_ratio.description: Compression ratio achieved when sealing the payload

checksum.description: BLAKE3 hash of the sealed payload
